senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Jabneh, Jamnia, north of west of Jerusalem, seat of the Sanhedrin after the destruction of Jerusalem.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 56b:5">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>תן לי י׳ וכ׳</he> give me (promise to spare) J. and her scholars; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 4:5">Ab. d’R. N. ch. IV</cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:6">Keth. IV, 6</cite>, a. fr. <he>בכרם בי׳</he> in the college of R. Johanan b. Zackai in J., v. <cite ref="K01229"><he>כֶּרֶם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:5:5">Y. Sot. VII, end, 22ᵃ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:13">Tosef. Dem. I, 13</cite> <he>אוצר י׳ וכ׳</he> the store of provision in J., inside of the fortification.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:14">Ib. 14</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 3:15">Tosef. Makhsh. III, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:4:7">Y. Dem. III, 23ᶜ</cite> bot.; v. <cite ref="N00426"><he>נָזָה</he></cite>.
